title: Application Whitelisting / AppLocker Service (AppIDSvc) is Disabled
description: The Application Identity service (AppIDSvc) determines and verifies the identity of applications for AppLocker and Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC).
impact: Unvetted third-party executables and living-off-the-land scripts can execute without application control policy enforcement.
remediation_guidance: Enable and start the Application Identity service: Set-Service -Name 'AppIDSvc' -StartupType Automatic; Start-Service -Name 'AppIDSvc'
